views.name: contacts_directory
views.definition:
WITH ctx AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT private.is_researcher() AS researcher,
            private.current_features() AS feats
        )
 SELECT c.id,
    c.agency,
    a.name AS agency_name,
    c.full_name,
    c.title,
    c.office,
        CASE
            WHEN ctx.researcher OR ('contacts.full'::text = ANY (ctx.feats)) THEN c.email::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS email,
        CASE
            WHEN ctx.researcher OR ('contacts.full'::text = ANY (ctx.feats)) THEN c.phone
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS phone,
    ctx.researcher OR ('contacts.full'::text = ANY (ctx.feats)) AS full_access
   FROM contacts c
     JOIN agencies a ON a.code = c.agency
     CROSS JOIN ctx
  WHERE ctx.researcher OR ('contacts.directory'::text = ANY (ctx.feats));

views.name: report_library
views.definition:
WITH ctx AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT private.is_researcher() AS researcher,
            private.current_features() AS feats,
            private.current_agencies() AS ags
        )
 SELECT r.id,
    r.title,
    r.agency,
    a.name AS agency_name,
    r.tier_required,
    r.published_at,
        CASE
            WHEN c.subscriber THEN r.category
            ELSE NULL::report_category
        END AS category,
        CASE
            WHEN c.subscriber THEN r.summary
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS summary,
        CASE
            WHEN c.subscriber THEN rs.full_name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS author_name,
        CASE
            WHEN c.subscriber THEN ( SELECT array_agg(t.tag ORDER BY t.tag) AS array_agg
               FROM report_tags t
              WHERE t.report_id = r.id)
            ELSE NULL::text[]
        END AS tags,
    u.unlocked,
        CASE
            WHEN u.unlocked THEN r.body
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS body,
        CASE
            WHEN u.unlocked THEN r.attachment_path
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS attachment_path
   FROM reports r
     JOIN agencies a ON a.code = r.agency
     LEFT JOIN researchers rs ON rs.id = r.author_id
     CROSS JOIN ctx
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ctx.researcher OR ('reports.preview'::text = ANY (ctx.feats)) AS subscriber) c
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ctx.researcher OR (('reports.read.'::text || r.tier_required::text) = ANY (ctx.feats)) AND ((r.agency = ANY (ctx.ags)) OR ('agencies.all'::text = ANY (ctx.feats))) AS unlocked) u
  WHERE r.status = 'published'::report_status;
